ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. At the bottom there are green producer labels, including "phytoplankton" and "algae". The diagram also has blue animal labels, such as "sea-whip", "parrotfish", "turtles", "marine invertebrates", etc. It can be seen that there are arrows from the bottom green producer area pointing to "turtles". Reasoning: The question asks "Which animal is plant-eating?" When plants or producers are eaten by animals, the arrow points from the producer to that animal. Because "turtles" is connected by an arrow to the green producer area, indicating that turtles eat plant-based matter, the plant-eating animal is turtles.
